label: 雨夜街道 → 晴天同街角（2.0）
prompt: Create a 15-second, emotionally devastating cinematic 3D video using two character references. This is a fictional film set depicting a choreographed stunt sequence. Both performers are adult actors. No real harm, no blood, no graphic injury. The "zombie" is a costume performance.
CHARACTER A: [Insert Character A / Reference Image 1]
CHARACTER B: [Insert Character B / Reference Image 2]
Character A is the survivor. Character B is someone deeply loved by Character A — their [partner / best friend / family member] — who has tragically transformed into a zombie.
Preserve the exact facial identity, recognizable hairstyle, body proportions, and distinctive appearance of both characters throughout the video.
Character B always faces Character A and never moves behind her.
On a dark, rain-soaked city street at night, Character A stands trembling under a flickering neon sign, holding Character B's folded umbrella in both hands.
Begin with a tight cinematic close-up of Character A's tearful face. Rain runs down their cheeks together with tears. Their eyes are red and filled with heartbreak. Their lips tremble.

Across the street, Character B — zombified, pale, stiff, but still unmistakably the person Character A loves — stands facing Character A. She does not move behind Character A. Her head tilts slowly, her fingers twitch, and her cloudy eyes track Character A's face — a choreographed zombie performance, not a real threat.
Neon reflections shimmer on the wet asphalt. Cold blue-violet lighting and deep shadows create a tragic, oppressive atmosphere.
Cut sharply to an extreme close-up of Character B's horrifying undead face. Rain drips from her hair.
Character B has pale grey skin, cloudy white eyes, dark veins, hollow facial features, disheveled hair.
The expression is frightening and inhuman, yet the character remains unmistakably recognizable as Character B.
Use an intense, nearly motionless close-up with shallow depth of field, capturing subtle facial twitches and rain on her skin.
No excessive gore or graphic wounds. No biting. No blood. Camera locked, no movement.
Cut back to Character A, still crying, the umbrella lowered.
Character A looks at Character B's face and recognizes the person they love beneath the undead features. Character A hesitates one final time, overwhelmed by grief and love.
Instead of backing away, Character A slowly opens the umbrella and holds it out toward Character B, not in aggression, but in silent grief and recognition.
Their tearful expression shows painful acceptance and love.
For a brief instant, Character A remains motionless with the umbrella held open.
Character B sees the umbrella. Something familiar flickers in her cloudy eyes.
She suddenly runs forward across the wet street, straight into Character A's arms, and wraps her arms around her. Character A closes their eyes and holds her.
Camera: locked medium shot from a slight side angle, slow push in. Do not orbit around the characters. Keep both faces visible and clearly separated.
SHOT 4 — THE MEMORY / MATCH CUT (10–15 SECONDS)
Hard cut — no dissolve — at the exact moment Character B's arms settle around Character A.
The rainy night street becomes the exact same street corner on a bright, sunny afternoon.

Both characters are now completely alive and healthy, restored to their normal human appearance exactly matching the reference images, wearing clean everyday clothing that fits their original gender and identity.

IMPORTANT: The embrace movement must continue seamlessly across the cut. Match the hand position and body distance exactly across the cut: Character B's arms in the same place around Character A, Character A's arms in the same place around Character B.
The same embrace becomes warm, alive, and joyful.
Character A holds Character B tightly.
Both characters hold each other affectionately, reunited at last.
Their faces express profound relief, tenderness, and bittersweet happiness.
Golden afternoon sunlight illuminates their hair and faces. A gentle breeze moves through the street.
The camera slowly pulls back in a locked medium-wide shot to reveal the peaceful street corner, ending on the two characters embracing under the warm sun. No orbiting, no circling.

4K cinematic quality, photorealistic 3D rendering, film-quality animation, highly detailed facial expressions, realistic tears, natural skin textures, detailed hair simulation, physically accurate lighting, volumetric sunlight, atmospheric rain, realistic clothing physics, cinematic depth of field, professional film color grading.
First 10 seconds: dark, cold, desaturated, frightening, emotionally tense.
Final 5 seconds: luminous, warm, golden, peaceful, nostalgic, emotionally healing.

Avoid body merging, limb overlap distortion, face morphing, identity drift, extra arms or hands. No rapid camera movement, no orbiting camera. No blood, no gore, no biting, no graphic injury. No text, no music. Keep both faces clearly separated and recognizable in every frame.
First scene: rain on asphalt, distant city hum, shaky breathing, quiet sobbing, rising cinematic tension.
Zombie close-up: unsettling breathing and a subtle low-frequency rumble.
The embrace: a soft, emotional swell, then hard cut to silence.
Final scene: warm ambient street tone, gentle emotional swell (sound design only, no music track).
